title: Day must be a whole number from 1 to 31
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type "Day X" in Name.
  3. Click the Day box.
  4. Type 0 in the Day box.
  5. Replace it with 32.
  6. Replace it with 2.5.
  7. Replace it with 31.
  8. Replace it with 1.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 2: the Name reads Day X.
  • Step 3: "Due day of the following month" is chosen.
  • Step 4: the message "Enter a day from 1 to 31." shows under the Day box.
  • Step 5: the message "Enter a day from 1 to 31." shows.
  • Step 6: the message "Enter a day from 1 to 31." shows.
  • Step 7: the message disappears and the blue line shows.
  • Step 8: no message, and the blue line shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R9, Day: “Day not a whole number from 1 to 31: "Enter a day from 1 to 31."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Day out of range | "Enter a day from 1 to 31." | Inline error, clears as soon as the number is valid”
  • Key Decisions: “Net terms run from 1 to 365 days.”
